steps.title: Prepare 1x TE Buffer
steps.instruction: Calculate total 1x TE volume needed: 200 µL per technical replicate, 100 µL per standard, plus 3–400 µL for DNA‑standard dilution and extra for pipetting loss (e.g., for 20 samples + 8 standards + DNA standard: 20×200 + 8×100 + 300 = 5100 µL → prepare 5500 µL). Dilute the 20× TE stock (provided) by mixing volume = final volume/20 with water (final – volume TE). Example: to make 5 mL, combine 250 µL 20× TE and 4750 µL water.

substeps.instruction: Calculate required TE volume per replicate and standard.
Add extra 3–400 µL for DNA‑standard dilution and losses.
Dilute 20× TE: TE volume = final volume ÷ 20; water = final volume – TE volume.

steps.title: Make DNA Standard Dilutions
steps.instruction: Dilute the 100 µg/mL DNA stock (provided) to the required working concentrations:

substeps.instruction: High range (2 ng/µL): mix 6 µL DNA stock with 294 µL 1× TE.
Middle range (0.5 ng/µL): mix 2 µL DNA stock with 398 µL 1× TE.

High‑sensitivity (0.05 ng/µL): mix 0.2 µL DNA stock with 399.8 µL 1× TE. Because 0.2 µL is inaccurate, first prepare a 10‑fold dilution of the stock and then add 2 µL of that dilution to 398 µL 1× TE.

steps.title: Dilute PicoGreen Reagent
steps.instruction: Determine total diluted PicoGreen volume: 100 µL per standard and per unknown sample plus extra for loss (e.g., 8 standards + 20 samples = 28 × 100 µL = 2800 µL → prepare 3000 µL). Dilute PicoGreen 1:200 with 1× TE: PicoGreen volume = final volume ÷ 200; TE volume = final – PicoGreen volume. Example: 15 µL PicoGreen + 2985 µL 1× TE. Keep the diluted reagent protected from light until use.

substeps.instruction: Multiply by 100 µL and add extra for pipetting loss.
TE volume = total volume – PicoGreen volume.
Mix gently and store in the dark.

steps.title: Set Up 96-Well Plate
steps.instruction: Use a NUNC 96‑well flat‑bottom black plate. Cover with aluminium foil inside the lid. Mark sample identifiers on the lid and draw a layout diagram. Arrange standards in duplicate (or more) according to the chosen range tables:

substeps.instruction: Table 1 high range: 0–100 ng/µL (2 µL sample).
Table 2 low range: 0–25 ng/µL (2 µL sample).
Table 3 low range: 0–2.5 ng/µL (2 µL sample).

steps.title: Add TE to Wells
steps.instruction: Add 1× TE to each standard well as specified in Tables 1‑3. Add 98 µL of 1× TE to each sample well. Prepare two duplicate wells for each sample.

steps.title: Add DNA Samples
steps.instruction: Pipette 2–5 µL of each DNA sample into its designated sample wells.

steps.title: Add DNA Standards
steps.instruction: Add the appropriate diluted DNA standard (from Step 2) to each standard well according to Tables 1‑3.

steps.title: Add Diluted PicoGreen
steps.instruction: Dispense 100 µL of the diluted PicoGreen reagent into every well (samples and standards). Mix by pipetting up and down 5–10 times.

steps.title: Incubate in Dark
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate at room temperature in the dark for at least 5 minutes (00:05:00) before reading.

steps.title: Measure and Calculate DNA
steps.instruction: Read fluorescence with a plate reader. Create a calibration curve in Excel (fluorescence = x‑axis, DNA amount in ng from standard wells = y‑axis). Use the trend‑line equation to determine DNA amount (ng) in each sample, then divide by the volume of sample added (2–5 µL) to obtain concentration (ng/µL).
